evd.escudo_perdido.desc: The magnetopause drops below {umbral} planetary radii — it no longer provides significant protection.
evd.campo_debil.titulo: 🧲 Magnetic field drops below the active threshold
evd.atmosfera_perdida.desc: The atmospheric mass drops below {pct}% of its initial value.
evd.dinamo_apagado.desc: Rm drops below {umbral} — the core stops actively generating a field.
evd.dinamo_encendido.desc: Rm exceeds {umbral} — the core starts actively generating a field.
evd.circularizacion.desc: The eccentricity drops from {e0} to below {umbral} due to tidal friction.
evd.luna_perdida.titulo: 🌑 The moon crashes into the planet
evd.luna_perdida.desc: The moon's orbital distance collapses toward the planet.
evd.luna_escapa.desc: The moon's orbital distance grows to several times its initial value.
evd.colision.titulo: 💥 The planet falls into the star
evd.colision.desc: The orbital semi-major axis crosses the collision threshold (a < 0.01 AU). The impact itself and its effect on the star are not modeled.
